goal: Make the current app visually match the extracted Stitch Stage 4 prototype layouts while preserving existing backend behavior, route paths, API contracts, data fetching, mutation handlers, workspace security, and component responsibility mapping.

source_of_truth_policy.rule: Stitch controls visual layout. Current app controls routes, data, actions, auth, APIs, and persistence.

non_negotiable_repair_rules: Do not change database schema in this repair layer.
Do not change API request or response contracts unless a separate backend ticket is approved.

Do not remove or bypass workspace scoping, auth checks, same-origin checks, idempotency keys, import queue behavior, scraper contracts, PDF upload behavior, discovery candidate actions, catalog writes, vendor writes, or AI provider health/routing behavior.
Do not paste Tailwind CDN, external prototype scripts, inline showState controls, href="#" links, demo state toggles, or hard-coded sample IDs into production routes.
Do preserve component responsibility mapping: forms submit through current form/client components, tables navigate through current route links, and mutations continue using current API routes.
Do provide populated-looking empty states where local data is sparse so the layout still resembles the Stitch visual structure without inventing production records.
Do not implement deferred features from the selective feature table.

tickets.title: Create visual parity baseline and component mapping matrix
acceptance_criteria: Create a route-by-route matrix mapping each Stitch screenshot region to the current React page/component responsible for behavior.
Record which visual elements are allowed to become static empty-state placeholders and which must be backed by real data.
Identify all deferred prototype elements and mark them as excluded from visual parity.
Define the screenshot capture dimensions for desktop, tablet, and mobile validation.
Do not modify app source code in this ticket.
validation_steps: Verify every prototype screen has one live route mapping or an explicit no-route note.
Verify every live route action maps to an existing component/API path.
Verify deferred features are explicitly excluded before implementation tickets run.

tickets.title: Repair shared shell and global visual system for Stitch parity
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar visually matches Stitch proportions, typography, active route marker, spacing, and persistent fixed-left layout.
Main canvas uses Stitch warm off-white background, content offset, max-width behavior, and topbar/header rhythm.
Shared card, table, toolbar, badge, button, form, drawer, and empty-state primitives support the Stitch layouts.
Topbar excludes deferred notification/help buttons unless already backed by approved behavior.
Route paths and workspace navigation behavior remain unchanged.
validation_steps: Run typecheck and route contract tests.
Verify no production href="#", showState, Tailwind CDN script, or external prototype JavaScript exists.
Capture shell screenshots for at least /app, /app/imports, /app/catalog, and /app/settings/ai.

tickets.title: Repair overview and imports layouts to match Stitch screenshots
acceptance_criteria: /app matches the Stitch overview composition: breadcrumb/header, quick actions, active jobs area, status/summary panels, and compact operational cards.
/app/imports matches the Stitch imports composition: method chooser cards, operational status header, recent/import job sections, and dense table styling.
Real DB counts/jobs remain the data source, but empty states keep the same structural slots as the prototype.
Open catalog, Start import, View active jobs, Website import, PDF import, and Open job links preserve current route behavior.
No fake production job IDs, vendors, or records are introduced.
validation_steps: Run import workflow and live page tests.
Capture and compare /app, /app/imports, and /app/imports/jobs screenshots against the prototype baseline.
Confirm sparse local data still renders the same page skeleton.

tickets.title: Repair website, PDF, and import job detail workflows to match Stitch screenshots
acceptance_criteria: /app/imports/website matches the Stitch wizard layout while keeping WebsiteImportForm submission, idempotency, and job handoff behavior.
Detected Category Tree remains approved and visually matches the Stitch tree region when category data exists; otherwise an empty tree skeleton is shown.
/app/imports/pdf matches the Stitch PDF import layout while preserving the current upload API and accessible error/status messages.
/app/imports/jobs/:jobId matches the Stitch job detail layout while preserving retry, cancel, event timeline, category jobs, and discovery handoff behavior.
Download Analysis Report PDF remains excluded.
validation_steps: Run import API and category job tests.
Run browser/manual flow for website form, PDF form, job retry/cancel disabled states, and category selector.
Capture screenshots for website import, PDF import, and job detail states.

tickets.title: Repair discovery, catalog, and catalog form layouts to match Stitch screenshots
acceptance_criteria: /app/discovery/:sessionId matches the Stitch review workspace layout while preserving search, filter, select, preview, import, ignore, archive, and save behavior.
Candidate preview drawer visually matches Stitch and keeps keyboard close/focus behavior.
AI inference details remain conditional on backed candidate payload data.
/app/catalog matches the Stitch catalog toolbar/table layout while preserving real item query, search/filter, category filter, row navigation, and new item route.
/app/catalog/new matches the Stitch form layout while preserving CatalogItemForm submission and product/service segmented control.
Catalog mobile floating create button remains excluded.
validation_steps: Run discovery and catalog contract tests.
Capture screenshots for discovery, catalog, and catalog create form.
Verify no client-only demo toggles ship from the prototype code.

tickets.title: Repair vendors and AI settings layouts to match Stitch screenshots
acceptance_criteria: /app/vendors matches the Stitch vendors layout while preserving real vendor list, new vendor route, and open vendor route.
Vendor state toggles and vendor footer links remain excluded.
/app/settings/ai matches the Stitch AI provider settings layout while preserving provider add, health check, manual fallback, save routing, and credential privacy behavior.
Provider documentation/support links remain excluded.
Permission/provider summary cards remain present without exposing credential values.
validation_steps: Run vendor and AI settings route/API tests.
Capture screenshots for vendors and AI settings.
Verify credentials and secret-like strings are not exposed in HTML, logs, or preview files.

tickets.title: Validate Stitch visual parity repair with screenshots and regression suite
acceptance_criteria: Each live route has fresh desktop screenshot evidence mapped to the corresponding Stitch screen.png.
Tablet and mobile screenshots are captured for shell, imports, catalog, and discovery surfaces.
Visual QA notes record any intentional differences caused by real-data constraints or deferred features.
typecheck, contract tests, and production build pass.
Existing scraper, PDF, AI settings, import, discovery, catalog, vendor, auth, and workspace behavior remains covered by regression tests.
The repair evidence clearly states whether visual parity is complete or lists exact remaining deltas.
validation_steps: Run corepack pnpm typecheck.
Run corepack pnpm test:contracts.
Run corepack pnpm --filter @source-blendr/web build.
Run local app with SOURCE_BLENDR_DEV_AUTH=1 and DATABASE_URL configured.
Capture route screenshots against the Stitch source package.
Record screenshot paths, viewport sizes, route URLs, and remaining deltas.

batches.purpose: Establish visual parity and component mapping before touching layout code.
Repair shared shell and visual primitives first so page-level parity uses one system.
Repair independent route groups after shell parity is established.
Repair import workflow/detail surfaces after imports parent layout is stable.
Run screenshot visual QA and full regression validation.

dependency_notes: TICKET-053 must complete first because it defines which current components own each prototype visual section.
TICKET-054 must complete before page parity work because sidebar, topbar, spacing, table, card, and form primitives affect every screenshot.
TICKET-055, TICKET-057, and TICKET-058 can run after shell parity because they cover independent top-level route groups.
TICKET-056 waits for TICKET-055 because website/PDF/job detail visuals depend on imports workspace patterns.
TICKET-059 is the final gate and cannot pass without screenshot evidence or an explicit user-approved visual QA waiver.
